title: Locally integrable Radon–Nikodym density representing an absolutely continuous compact-finite measure on C_c
statement: Let X be a locally compact Hausdorff space with a countable basis, equipped with its Borel σ-algebra. Let μ₀ and ξ be measures on X, both finite on compact sets, with ξ ≪ μ₀. Then there is a measurable function g : X → ℝ, μ₀-integrable on every compact subset of X, such that for every f ∈ C_c(X, ℝ) the function x ↦ f(x)·g(x) is μ₀-integrable and ∫ f dξ = ∫ f(x)·g(x) dμ₀(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ₀ ξ : Measure X), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ₀ → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ξ → ξ ≪ μ₀ → ∃ g : X → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → IntegrableOn g K μ₀) ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ, Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) μ₀ ∧ ∫ x, f x ∂ξ = ∫ x, f x * g x ∂μ₀
